text:
asim: quick postmortem follow-up  pattern: several features rolled out too wide with no fast rollback leash. need a tight plan: owners, short timelines, and one synthetic test to validate rollback end-to-end.

lana: I'll take the rollout "leash" design (how we express caps + TTL + approver overrides). goal: spec + JSON schema in 4 days.

diego: I'll build the rollback actuator (idempotent endpoint + audit event + reconciliation). prototype in 1 week.

harper: ops wants a single verification URL returned by the actuator so oncall can click and run checks. i'll draft the checklist.

ops-bot: monitor: 5 flags exceeded 15% exposure in last 3 months. see /dash/rollouts/high-risk.

asim: proposed constraints:
- default route cap = 5% (hard)
- org cap = 15% (soft, requires approver with TTL)
- rollback triggers: error_rate > 1.5% sustained 3m OR latency_p95 jump > 2x
- rollback action: flip flag + traffic-shift to fallback + emit audit id + reconcile loop verify within 30s

lana: small policy example to review:
```json
{"policy":"leash","route":"*/rank","cap":0.05,"soft":true,"ttl_minutes":30}
```

diego: sample actuator call:
POST /internal/rollback {flag: "rank-v2", target: "stable", reason: "auto:err_rule"} -> returns {audit_id}

harper: oncall checklist (short): 1) follow link, 2) confirm flag state, 3) traffic % reverted, 4) basic sample responses, 5) escalate if any fail.

asim: action items:
- A1: leash policy schema + validation (owner: lana)  due: 2024-06-02
- A2: rollback actuator + audit stream (owner: diego)  due: 2024-06-09
- A3: verification URL + oncall checklist (owner: harper)  due: 2024-05-29
- A4: synthetic rollback test in staging (owner: diego + infra)  due: 2024-06-12
- A5: dashboard tile for high-exposure flags + weekly alert (owner: lana)  due: 2024-06-16
- A6: quarterly rollout-risk review cadence (owner: ops)  due: 2024-07-01

lana: note: policy must include an "emergency bypass" boolean only settable by approver and with TTL. will include unit tests.

diego: dependency: needs kinesis audit topic and feature-flag safe-toggle lib. i'll open infra tickets.
harper: i'll add exact metric queries to the checklist so oncall has copy-paste queries.

asim: please add acceptance criteria to tickets before EOD Friday. small acceptance examples: unit tests for schema, e2e synthetic that triggers rollback, audit id visible in stream.

lana: will drop the schema PR and a tiny CLI helper for ops to bump caps temporarily.

diego: will wire the actuator to the reconciliation loop and schedule a synthetic run. ops-bot: please run the synthetic at 1795554700 in staging.

ops-bot: synthetic rollback scheduled for 1795554700 (staging)  will run smoke + checklist.

asim: thanks team. i'll track updates on the postmortem follow-up board and ping at next platform sync. :thumbsup:
